thread.title: Trump Today: President says there’s ‘good chance’ he’ll declare emergency to build wall - MarketWatch

author: Robert Schroeder
title: Trump Today: President says there’s ‘good chance’ he’ll declare emergency to build wall - MarketWatch
text:
Getty Images President Donald Trump speaks Friday during a meeting in the Cabinet Room of the White House about the fight against human trafficking on the southern border of the U.S. President Donald Trump strongly suggested on Friday he’ll use an emergency declaration to build a wall along the U.S-Mexico border, and shifted his message to completing the barrier he says his administration is already constructing.
GOING IT ALONE?
Trump said “I think there’s a good chance we’ll have to do that” when asked if he’d decided on declaring a national emergency to construct the wall.
In a messaging shift, Trump also said a chant in support of his proposal should now be “finish the wall,” instead of “build the wall,” since in his words, “we’re building a lot of wall.”
The Associated Press pointed out as recently as last month that no new miles of barrier construction have been completed under Trump . Existing fencing has been strengthened or replaced, the AP noted, and about 650 miles of barrier are in service. That’s out of a border that’s more than 1,900 miles in total .
During a meeting on human trafficking, Trump told reporters to “listen closely” to his State of the Union speech on Tuesday night when asked for more details about the wall.
Also read: Here are the nearly two dozen Democrats running for president or in the mix .
DEFENDING TREATY SUSPENSION
After the White House said the U.S. would suspend its obligations under a nuclear arms control treaty with Russia, Trump defended the move by saying, “unless we’re going to have something we all agree to, we can’t be put at the disadvantage of going by a treaty, limiting what we do, when somebody else doesn’t go by that treaty.”
As The Wall Street Journal reported, the announcement followed revelations that Russia has expanded its deployment of its Novator 9M729 missile . Russia insists its move is compliant with the treaty.
FOXCONN NEWS ‘GREAT’
After Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.05% supplier Foxconn Technology Group said it’s decided to go ahead with constructing a facility in Wisconsin — two days after saying building that plant would be unfeasible — Trump tweeted, “Great news on Foxconn in Wisconsin after my conversation with Terry Gou!”
The Taiwanese company said it’s moving forward with the planned facility after “a personal conversation” between the firm’s chairman Gou and Trump.
